headline: Government won’t put together ‘shopping list’ for public to stockpile for emergency – UK politics live

members.title: Government won’t put together ‘shopping list’ for public to stockpile for emergency – UK politics live
members.lead: Ministers have repeated several warnings in the last 18 months about the threat of hybrid attacks from overseas Good morning from London, where we’re less than a week from Andy Burnham and John Healey’s first budget, and the Government has been telling people to build up 72 hours of supplies in case of a disaster. We’ll be bringing you updates throughout the day. I’m Harry Taylor. The Government has said that will not be putting together a “shopping list” for the public to buy in anticipation of a disaster, despite launching a campaign on Thursday which told people to stock up on supplies. members.title: Andy Burnham says he has emergency stockpile of beans, soup and Twiglets
members.lead: PM’s revelation follows launch of advice for households to have enough water and food to get by in civil emergency UK politics live – latest updates Andy Burnham has stockpiles of beans, soup and Twiglets in case of a civil emergency, he has said, adding that a new government campaign was not reason for panic buying. The prime minister was questioned on his domestic supply situation after the Be Ready campaign advised households to have enough bottled water and long-life food to keep going in case of an emergency, such as one caused by a weather event or cyber-attack.
